title: Smart List & Export Functionality for Member Reviews
text:
## Smart List & Export Functionality for Member Reviews
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079365

## Overview
The Member Reviews page includes tools for exporting reviews and creating Smart Lists based on the current search results.
To access these options, navigate to Interactions → Member Reviews. Then, open the List Actions menu and choose one of the available actions.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616838/original/3DLU7yWxMd_eTvUbmGWo_0JKEJQyC35M1Q.jpeg?1687995753 | alt: ]

## Export Reviews
Select Export Current Results from the List Actions menu to download all reviews that match the current filters.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616841/original/TpO-LmOYYrKnI1gcC2u7nbZKjPNrBjUrMg.jpeg?1687995766 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616843/original/CgBsgImSWiS-jO0rAVKpR_wlRRB1TBqs5Q.jpeg?1687995775 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616844/original/fDqHp8bjFpIKmYasDBk6ZAUhNVMZ-L4ysg.jpeg?1687995782 | alt: ]
The exported file is downloaded as a ZIP archive containing a CSV file with the review data.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616852/original/VHOT65upzwbXoCE0cqxEVZZBbvLHBQmlFg.jpeg?1687995798 | alt: ]
Note: Exporting member reviews requires the Export Member Data feature. If the feature is not installed, the export option will not be available.
» Export Member Data Add-On
Extract the ZIP file to access the exported reviews in CSV format.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616855/original/QCHYQ302upUeWvQRi2Dz_sPXYmLTMbFtag.jpeg?1687995814 | alt: ]

## Creating a Smart List
Select the "Create Smart List from Results" option from the drop-down:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616885/original/kowyPewt2yXAoGQVqnNGRiLd2BfKEA85FQ.jpeg?1687995829 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616891/original/pKc6Z49DtO7mnASAh-vBhydIK8v8go6gUg.jpeg?1687995855 | alt: ]
After the Smart List has been created, select Go To Reviews Smart List to view and manage it.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127616906/original/E7E0EUGqSKmp32ozysfT6PfZ7hypxR1wEg.jpeg?1687995880 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169876755/original/kcYxVSI7hadSgSN0CwN5ETaOfVp_OgchGA.png?1761964043 | alt: ]
